rationale: features_open/012's field-based fix, scheduled by the owner (DECISIONS_2026-08-11 ruling 2: 'this lane's next round immediately after the census' - the census completed this morning, corr e74974b3, read-out in lane NOTES 2026-08-11). The defect: the recompose_pages release happens in validate (v3_site_actions.go:3105 pre-filters existingPages before convergence), but seed 362 instructs the PLANNER to re-emit every built page's realised section list verbatim, with only a prose escape ('only when the briefing explicitly asks...'). The planner is never told WHICH pages were released, so a recompose_pages request whose intent is not ALSO restated in the briefing silently no-ops: the planner re-emits the realised list, validate releases a page whose proposal equals its realised state, nothing changes, no error (LANDMINES 2026-08-10 entry; the durable tell RECOMPOSE_INTENT_NOT_REALISED shipped in v1.0.1283). The owner's 2026-08-10 ruling named this round as the permanent fix, in the RFC_010 section 2 shape: authority on a shared behaviour ships as a prompt-visible FIELD, not as prose two systems away. The fix is one config seed: the plan_site template gains (1) an inline 'REDESIGN REQUESTED' marker on the listing row of each page named in input_data.spec.recompose_pages, and (2) flag semantics appended to the 362 instruction paragraph (flagged pages: propose fresh, sections shown are context only; unflagged pages: preserve-exactly unchanged). No input_fields change - input_data is already an input_field of plan_site, and the spec's travel path input_data.spec is the 012 feature file's proven plumbing (update_site_spec_from_item_action.go:74 precedent). SUBMITTED WITH FORCE=1: the client-side path filter reads the single edit (a seed under docs/agent_docs/sql_for_agents/) as docs content, but the artefact this seed edits is the live agent_definitions row for build-site-planner - platform behaviour, not documentation; the precedent rounds (362/328/330) carried their seeds in-scope only because Go edits rode alongside.

plan.risks: 1) The instruction paragraph (edit 2's flag semantics) renders unconditionally - on replans with no recompose_pages it describes a case with an empty match set. Judged harmless (the closing sentence 'Pages NOT flagged keep the preserve-exactly rule above' is true and reinforcing when nothing is flagged) and simpler than a second conditional; the per-row markers are strictly field-gated. 2) A page named in recompose_pages that the LLM still re-emits verbatim remains possible - the marker makes it deliberate rather than blind, and RECOMPOSE_INTENT_NOT_REALISED (live) records it durably either way; retiring the prose escape entirely is the registered follow-up after a live recompose run proves the field. 3) The seed is config - live immediately on apply, no image roll needed; application is gated on this round's verdict and the field is unused fleet-wide today (measured zero), so there is no window in which an in-flight consumer sees half a change.
